articles.title_en: Competition for Attention and News Quality
articles.title_cn: 注意力竞争与新闻质量
articles.abstract_en: Over the past decades the number of news outlets has increased dramatically, but the quality of news products has declined. We propose a model to reconcile these facts where consumers’ attention allocation decisions not only depend on but also affect news outlets’ quality choices. When competition is intensified by new entries, the informativeness of the news industry rises. Thus, attention is diverted from existing outlets, reducing their incentives to improve news quality, which begets a downward spiral. Furthermore, when attention becomes cheaper, a larger number of news outlets can be accommodated in equilibrium, but news quality still falls. (JEL D83, L15, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，新闻机构的数量急剧增加，但新闻产品的质量却有所下降。我们提出了一个模型来调和这些事实，其中消费者的注意力分配决策不仅取决于新闻机构的质量选择，而且影响这些选择。当新进入者加剧竞争时，新闻业的信息量上升。因此，注意力从现有机构转移，降低了它们改进新闻质量的激励，从而引发恶性循环。此外，当注意力变得更便宜时，均衡中可以容纳更多的新闻机构，但新闻质量仍然下降。(JEL D83, L15, L82)

articles.abstract_en: We analyze the incentive and welfare consequences of job references in a large economy marked by moral hazard, limited liability, exogenous job separation, and structural unemployment. In the firm-optimal equilibrium, employers provide references whenever production is successful, and workers holding references are hired with certainty in the ensuing period. Compared to a setting without references: the bonus-contract offers are lower, yet the workers’ equilibrium effort is higher. Profits and welfare are higher, yet aggregate worker welfare is lower. Also, firms do not fully internalize the incentive effect of references and could typically increase profits and welfare by jointly raising bonuses. (JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个以道德风险、有限责任、外生离职和结构性失业为特征的大型经济体中，工作推荐信的激励和福利后果。在厂商最优均衡中，雇主在生产成功时提供推荐信，持有推荐信的工人在随后的时期被确定雇佣。与没有推荐信的情况相比：奖金合同报价更低，但工人的均衡努力水平更高。利润和福利更高，但工人总福利更低。此外，厂商并未完全内化推荐信的激励效应，通常可以通过联合提高奖金来增加利润和福利。(JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)

articles.title_en: Information Spillover in Multi-Good Adverse Selection
articles.title_cn: 多商品逆向选择中的信息溢出
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes information spillover in a multi-good adverse selection model in which a privately informed seller trades two different goods in two different markets. Buyers learn the seller’s information from both the market they participate in and the trading outcomes in the other market. We identify a sufficient negative correlation condition under which information spillover reduces efficiency loss. We also discover a novel type of coordination friction that leads to multiple equilibria, which can be welfare-ranked by the number of initial no-trade periods. When the sufficient negative correlation condition fails, the efficiency loss is the same as in the case without information spillover. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了多商品逆向选择模型中的信息溢出，在该模型中，拥有私人信息的卖方在两个不同市场上交易两种不同商品。买方从他们参与的市场以及其他市场的交易结果中了解卖方的信息。我们识别出一个充分的负相关条件，在该条件下信息溢出减少了效率损失。我们还发现了一种新型的协调摩擦，导致多重均衡，这些均衡可以根据初始无交易时期的数量进行福利排序。当充分的负相关条件不成立时，效率损失与没有信息溢出时的情况相同。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

articles.title_en: A Buyer Power Theory of Exclusive Dealing and Exclusionary Bundling
articles.title_cn: 买方势力下的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论
articles.abstract_en: We develop a unified theory of exclusive dealing and exclusionary bundling. In a framework with two competing manufacturers that supply their product(s) through a monopolist retailer, we show that buyer power restores the profitability of such practices involving inefficient exclusion. The mechanism underlying this exclusion is that the compensation required by the retailer to renounce selling the rival product erodes with its buyer power. We further show that our theory holds when buyer power differs across manufacturers or when the retailer can strategically narrow (or expand) its product assortment. (JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个统一的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论。在一个由两家竞争性制造商通过垄断零售商供应其产品的框架中，我们表明买方势力恢复了涉及低效排他的此类做法的盈利能力。这种排他背后的机制是，零售商放弃销售竞争对手产品所需的补偿随着其买方势力的增强而减少。我们进一步表明，当买方势力在不同制造商之间存在差异，或者当零售商可以战略性地缩小（或扩大）其产品种类时，我们的理论仍然成立。（JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81）

articles.title_cn: 均衡筛选与类别不平等
articles.abstract_en: We analyze equilibrium outcomes under costly screening of candidates from distinct categories. Candidates choose how much effort to invest in skill acquisition, and the screener decides how carefully to screen each candidate. Typically, there are multiple equilibria, and ex ante identical individuals in different categories can receive different equilibrium treatment. The imposition of a quota for an initially disadvantaged group can result in increased screening intensity and skill investment by destabilizing the least active equilibrium. The endogeneity of screening enables powerful comparative statics, which we use to unify different strands in the literature on discrimination. (JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在来自不同类别的候选人进行昂贵筛选下的均衡结果。候选人选择在技能获取上投入多少努力，而筛选者决定对每位候选人进行多仔细的筛选。通常存在多重均衡，且事前相同的个体在不同类别中可能受到不同的均衡待遇。对初始弱势群体实施配额可以通过破坏最不活跃的均衡来增加筛选强度和技能投资。筛选的内生性使得比较静态分析具有强大的力量，我们利用这一点来统一歧视文献中的不同分支。（JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51）

articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a mechanism-design approach to study criminal justice systems. We derive properties of optimal mechanisms for two notions of welfare distinguished by their treatment of deterrence. These properties provide insights into the effects of defendants’ private information about their guilt; highlight forces that may underlie certain features of existing systems, such as plea bargaining and binary verdicts and the separation of fact-finding and sentencing; and indicate directions for possible improvements of criminal trials, such as varying the standard for conviction across crimes. (JEL D82, K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种机制设计方法来研究刑事司法系统。我们推导了两种福利概念下最优机制的性质，这两种概念的区别在于对威慑的处理方式。这些性质为被告关于自己有罪的私人信息的影响提供了见解；强调了可能构成现有系统某些特征（如辩诉交易、二元裁决以及事实认定与量刑分离）的力量；并指出了刑事审判可能改进的方向，例如在不同犯罪之间调整定罪标准。（JEL D82, K41, K42）

articles.abstract_en: Firms and politicians, among others, invest heavily to influence people’s opinions. Because peers influence one another, these efforts must account for social networks. Using a model of opinion dynamics with a non-degenerate steady state, I develop a new measure of influence, and I highlight how opinion fluctuations impact influence campaigns. If agents interact less frequently with those holding different opinions, the variance of public opinion decreases. Consequently, a risk-averse planner focuses on persuading a large majority of agents in a small set of tightly knit groups, while a risk-loving planner makes much broader appeals. (JEL D11, D72, D83, D85, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 企业、政治家等主体投入大量资源以影响人们的观点。由于同伴之间相互影响，这些努力必须考虑社交网络。通过使用一个具有非退化稳态的观点动态模型，我开发了一种新的影响力衡量方法，并强调了观点波动如何影响影响力运动。如果主体与持有不同观点的人互动频率降低，公众观点的方差会减小。因此，风险规避的规划者侧重于说服少数紧密联系群体中的绝大多数主体，而风险偏好的规划者则进行更广泛的呼吁。（JEL D11, D72, D83, D85, Z13）

articles.title_en: The Dynamics of Property Rights in Modern Autocracies
articles.title_cn: 现代威权政体中的产权动态
articles.abstract_en: We study a dynamic model of property appropriation in autocracies. To maintain the appearance of the rule of law, an autocrat reassigns property only when the reassignment is acceptable to all affected citizens. Nevertheless, the autocrat can appropriate public and private property by exploiting enforcement gaps. After an adjustment period, wealth shares of public property and the private property of out-groups decline. The model rationalizes the connection between wealth inequality and privatization in many autocracies. Calibrating to Russian and Chinese data, simulations to mid-twenty-first century display widening wealth gaps between elites and the populace. Anocracies mitigate this outcome. (JEL D31, D72, K11, L33, O17, P26, P36)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究威权政体中财产侵占的动态模型。为了维持法治的表象，独裁者仅在重新分配对所有受影响公民都可接受时才重新分配财产。然而，独裁者可以利用执法漏洞侵占公共和私人财产。经过调整期后，公共财产和外部群体私人财产的财富份额下降。该模型合理化了许多威权政体中财富不平等与私有化之间的联系。根据俄罗斯和中国数据进行校准，模拟到二十一世纪中叶显示精英与民众之间的财富差距扩大。混合政体缓解了这一结果。(JEL D31, D72, K11, L33, O17, P26, P36)

articles.title_en: Similarity Nash Equilibria in Statistical Games
articles.title_cn: 统计博弈中的相似性纳什均衡
articles.abstract_en: A statistical game is a game in which strategic interaction is mediated via a binary outcome y, coupled with a prediction problem where a characteristic x of the game may be used to predict its outcome y based on past values of (x, y) . In Similarity Nash Equilibria, players combine statistical and strategic reasoning, using an estimate of y as a coordination device. They predict y by its similarity-weighted frequency and learn the optimal notion of similarity from the data. We prove that the model captures the importance of precedents and the endogenous formation of sunspots. (JEL C72, C73)
articles.abstract_cn: 统计博弈是一种博弈，其中战略互动通过二元结果y进行中介，并伴随一个预测问题，其中博弈的特征x可用于基于(x, y)的过去值来预测其结果y。在相似性纳什均衡中，参与者结合统计和战略推理，使用y的估计作为协调机制。他们通过y的相似性加权频率来预测y，并从数据中学习最优的相似性概念。我们证明该模型捕捉了先例的重要性和太阳黑子的内生形成。(JEL C72, C73)

articles.title_en: Bargaining over Treatment Choice under Disagreement
articles.title_cn: 分歧下的治疗选择谈判
articles.abstract_en: A group of experts with different prior beliefs must choose a treatment. A dataset is made public and leads to revisions of beliefs. We propose a model where the experts’ disagreements are resolved through bargaining, using the Nash bargaining solution. Experts bargain after disclosure of the dataset. Bargaining may lead to an inefficient use of information in a strong sense: experts receive a lower payoff in every state and for any prior belief (i.e., inadmissibility). Bargaining exhibits underreaction to information as compared to the normative solution in which experts bargain ex ante on the procedure used to exploit the data. (JEL C78, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 一组具有不同先验信念的专家必须选择一种治疗方法。一个数据集被公开，并导致信念的修正。我们提出了一个模型，其中专家的分歧通过谈判解决，使用纳什谈判解。专家在数据集披露后进行谈判。谈判可能导致在强意义上的信息利用无效率：专家在每个状态下和任何先验信念下都获得较低的收益（即不可采纳性）。与专家在事前就利用数据的程序进行谈判的规范解相比，谈判表现出对信息的反应不足。（JEL C78, D82, D83）

articles.title_cn: 噪声竞赛中的投标上限
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal bid caps in a multiplayer noisy contest in which a higher bid does not guarantee a sure win. The bid cap can be either rigid or flexible. The former imposes outright bidding restrictions on players’ bids, while the latter taxes bids. A designer structures the bid cap to maximize a weighted sum between aggregate bid and tax revenue. Our analysis characterizes the optimum. A rigid bid is always outperformed by flexible ones, and a laissez-faire policy—i.e., no cap—is optimal when the designer maximizes the aggregate bid. The results also generate novel practical implications. (JEL C72, D44, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了多人噪声竞赛中的最优投标上限，其中较高的投标并不保证确定获胜。投标上限可以是刚性的或灵活的。前者对参与者的投标施加直接的投标限制，而后者则对投标征税。设计者通过构建投标上限来最大化总投标与税收收入的加权和。我们的分析刻画了最优解。刚性投标总是劣于灵活投标，而当设计者最大化总投标时，自由放任政策——即无上限——是最优的。结果还产生了新颖的实践意义。（JEL C72, D44, D82）

articles.title_en: Keeping Up with “The Joneses”: Reference-Dependent Choice with Social Comparisons
articles.title_cn: 与“邻居”攀比：社会比较下的参照依赖选择
articles.abstract_en: Keeping up with “The Joneses” matters. This paper examines a model of reference-dependent choice where reference points are determined by social comparisons. An increase in the strength of social comparisons, even by only a few agents, increases consumption and decreases welfare for everyone. Strikingly, a higher marginal cost of consumption can increase welfare. In a labor market, social comparisons with coworkers create a big fish in a small pond effect, inducing incomplete labor market sorting. Further, it is the skilled workers with the weakest social networks who are induced to give up income to become the big fish. (JEL D85, J22, J24, J61)
articles.abstract_cn: 与“邻居”攀比很重要。本文研究了一个参照依赖选择模型，其中参照点由社会比较决定。社会比较强度的增加，即使仅由少数代理人引起，也会提高所有人的消费并降低福利。引人注目的是，更高的边际消费成本可以提高福利。在劳动力市场中，与同事的社会比较会产生“小池塘里的大鱼”效应，导致劳动力市场不完全分类。此外，正是那些社会网络最弱的熟练工人被诱导放弃收入以成为“大鱼”。(JEL D85, J22, J24, J61)

articles.abstract_en: We study the implications of the disclosure regime of ratings on the level of information released to the public. Specifically, we compare mandatory and voluntary disclosure. We analyze a model where the potential issuers are initially endowed with homogeneous soft information about their values before paying to acquire ratings. We find that for every accuracy level of the issuers’ initial information, voluntary disclosure results in a more informative equilibrium than mandatory disclosure. This finding identifies a dimension in which the existing European Union regulations that impose the mandatory disclosure of ratings may lead to a loss of information to the public. (JEL D21, D42, D43, D82, D83, G24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了评级的披露制度对向公众发布的信息水平的影响。具体而言，我们比较了强制披露和自愿披露。我们分析了一个模型，其中潜在的发行人最初拥有关于其价值的同质软信息，然后付费获取评级。我们发现，对于发行人初始信息的每一个准确度水平，自愿披露比强制披露产生更具信息量的均衡。这一发现确定了一个维度，即现有的欧盟法规强制要求披露评级可能导致公众信息的损失。（JEL D21, D42, D43, D82, D83, G24）

articles.abstract_en: We characterize decreasing impatience, a common behavioral phenomenon in intertemporal choice. Discount factors that display decreasing impatience are characterized through a convexity axiom for investments at fixed interest rates. Then we show that they are equivalent to a geometric average of generalized quasi-hyperbolic discount rates. Finally, they emerge through parimutuel preference aggregation of exponential discount factors. (JEL D15, D61, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了递减的不耐烦，这是跨期选择中一种常见的行为现象。表现出递减不耐烦的贴现因子通过固定利率下投资的凸性公理来刻画。然后我们证明它们等价于广义拟双曲贴现率的几何平均。最后，它们通过指数贴现因子的帕里穆图偏好聚合而出现。（JEL D15，D61，D91）

articles.title_en: Bounds on a Slope from Size Restrictions on Economic Shocks
articles.title_cn: 经济冲击规模限制下的斜率界限
articles.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning about the effect of one market-level variable (e.g., price) on another (e.g., quantity) in the presence of shocks to unobservables (e.g., preferences). We show that economic intuitions about the plausible size of the shocks can be informative about the parameter of interest. We illustrate with a main application to the grain market. (JEL D83, E23, G13, Q11)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在市场层面一个变量（如价格）对另一个变量（如数量）的影响，同时存在不可观测冲击（如偏好）的问题。我们表明，关于冲击合理规模的经济直觉可以告知感兴趣的参数。我们以谷物市场为主要应用进行说明。（JEL D83, E23, G13, Q11）
